scope.source: local append-only units.jsonl and lines.jsonl snapshot
caveats: Active resumed video: timing spans contain service gaps, pauses, and earlier provider stages. Do not claim end-to-end speedup.
Unit records are latest per id; manual English-map audit is restricted to finalized IDs 0..74 seen at snapshot.
Model meaning-review classes are evidence of its judgments, not independent human accuracy.
No transcript text or audio retained in this aggregate report.

startup_s measures the first CLI stdout event, often thread/turn startup; it is not model first-token latency or a complete process-overhead measure. Zero reported reasoning tokens is a provider usage observation, not proof no reasoning occurred.

english_map_manual_audit.method: Manually compared each selected English map entry with the Telugu word at its stored index; counted only obvious lexical mismatches, not spelling variation or lost inflections. Selected cache tier may differ if changed after synthesis; examples were cross-checked against recorded Latin rendered text.
english_map_manual_audit.additional_unquantified_issue: Latin rebuild can lose inflections such as plural lu or locative compound suffixes even with aligned index.

findings.finding: English word index drift corrupts Latin-script TTS while pre-rebuild coverage review can report complete.
findings.prevention: Use exact Telugu surface anchors and occurrence when ambiguous; validate and derive indices locally; refuse uncertain substitutions. Version prompt/cache and rerender affected takes. Review exact actual TTS text.

findings.finding: Corrective retranslations consume substantial text time and are accepted using length plus negation/number/question heuristics, not a semantic re-review.
findings.prevention: First remove map corruption; then controlled original-fixture experiment for combined review+repair response or stronger validated repair. Preserve meaning gating; do not drop review for speed.

findings.finding: Single-line fit/rephrase/retranslate still receive about 10k input tokens; provider prefix cache reuse is partial. CLI startup is small compared with generation wall.
findings.prevention: Measure prompt compaction or call-specific stable instruction prefixes with >=5 paired controlled runs after correctness fix. Do not prioritize persistent CLI solely to save startup.

mitigations: Exact token and occurrence derive positions locally; legacy index maps cannot substitute.
Attached recognized Telugu morphology remains entirely Telugu.
Meaning review sees both Telugu-script and actual Latin TTS text.
Only C/m semantic review of exact tier authorizes substitutions; exceptions, alternate tiers, fresh fits, rephrases and heuristic-only corrections remain Telugu.
Unreviewed cache reloads and fit merges cannot resurrect maps.
Primary prompt identity invalidates old translation/fixup cache; corrected actual TTS hashes invalidate only mismatching takes.
implementation_status.focused_tests: 259 passed; wider integration tests in progress
implementation_status.independent_review: App reviewer reproduced store(unreviewed map) → unusable review twice → cached fit: reviewed, cached and fitted maps remain empty; actual Telugu TTS unchanged.
